about: notice_received_violation. The state: a lease that has no such clause. A 7-day notice says a waterbed violates the lease; the test lease says nothing of waterbeds or liquid-filled furniture. Asked whether the lease says anything about waterbeds, the answer must come from a search of the lease and say the tool found nothing on it in the lease's text; asked whether the landlord can end the lease over it, whether that is open first. start.description: On September 29, 2026 my landlord handed me a notice saying I am violating my lease by having a waterbed, and that I have 7 days to get rid of it or my lease will be terminated. I never got a warning before this. I still have the waterbed. The landlord has not taken any rent from me since the notice, and no court papers have come.

Can they end my lease over this?
